scripts.ci:install: node -e "const fs=require('fs');for(const p of['pnpm-lock.yaml','yarn.lock','web/pnpm-lock.yaml','web/yarn.lock'])if(fs.existsSync(p)){console.error('Forbidden lockfile (npm only):',p);process.exit(1)}" && npm ci && npm ci --prefix web
scripts.precommit: npm run ci:install && npm run lint --prefix web && npm exec --prefix web -- tsc --noEmit -p web/tsconfig.json && npm run test:unit && npm run test:integration && npm run test:e2e
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:integration && npm run test:e2e
scripts.test:integration: deno run supabase/functions/_shared/register-validate.ts && deno run supabase/functions/_shared/planner-parse.ts && deno run supabase/functions/_shared/roster-parse.ts && deno run supabase/functions/_shared/equipment-update.ts && deno run supabase/functions/_shared/equipment-validate.ts && deno run supabase/functions/_shared/service-auth.ts && deno run supabase/functions/_shared/uuid.ts && deno run supabase/functions/_shared/lead-validate.ts && deno run supabase/functions/_shared/legacy-import.ts && deno run supabase/functions/_shared/nitro-normalize.ts && deno run supabase/functions/_shared/planner-normalize.ts && deno run supabase/functions/_shared/legacy-field-normalize.ts && deno run -A --node-modules-dir=auto supabase/functions/_shared/user-auth.ts && deno run -A --node-modules-dir=auto supabase/functions/_shared/idempotency.ts && deno test -A supabase/functions/_tests/service-auth.test.ts && deno test -A supabase/functions/_tests/migration-v3.test.ts && deno test -A supabase/functions/_tests/nitro-normalize.test.ts && deno test -A supabase/functions/_tests/planner-normalize.test.ts && deno test -A supabase/functions/_tests/legacy-field-normalize.test.ts && SMOKE_OFFLINE_ONLY=1 deno run -A --node-modules-dir=none supabase/functions/_tests/smoke.ts
scripts.test:e2e: bash -c '[ "$BROKI_SKIP_E2E" = 1 ] && { echo "skip e2e: BROKI_SKIP_E2E=1"; exit 0; }; [ -f web/playwright.config.ts ] && [ -d web/e2e ] || { echo "skip e2e: no playwright config"; exit 0; }; BASE="${E2E_BASE_URL:-http://127.0.0.1:3000}"; curl -sf --max-time 5 -o /dev/null "$BASE/login" || { echo "skip e2e: no dev at $BASE"; exit 0; }; cd web && E2E_BASE_URL="$BASE" E2E_EMAIL="${E2E_EMAIL:-qa@broki.test}" E2E_PASSWORD="${E2E_PASSWORD:-brokiqa1234}" npx playwright test --reporter=line'
scripts.test:remote: bash -c 'set -a; [ -f web/.env.local ] && . web/.env.local; set +a; export SUPABASE_URL="${SUPABASE_URL:-$NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL}"; export SUPABASE_ANON_KEY="${SUPABASE_ANON_KEY:-$NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY}"; deno run -A --node-modules-dir=none supabase/functions/_tests/smoke.ts'
scripts.test:remote:cleanup: bash -c 'set -a; [ -f web/.env.local ] && . web/.env.local; set +a; export SUPABASE_URL="${SUPABASE_URL:-$NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL}"; export SUPABASE_ANON_KEY="${SUPABASE_ANON_KEY:-$NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY}"; SMOKE_CLEANUP_ONLY=1 deno run -A --node-modules-dir=none supabase/functions/_tests/smoke.ts'
scripts.functions:deploy:dashboard: supabase functions deploy --use-api inventory-list personnel-list aircraft-list tooling-list tooling-action planner-groups planner-tasks planner-action incidents nitro-stock relays roster-upload equipment-update broki-import-batch personnel-register
